title: Cragpool Lake
wikitext:
[[Image:Cragpool Lake.jpg|thumb|Cragpool Lake]]
The '''Cragpool Lake''' is a small lake in [[Windshear Crag]].  An enormous structure created by [[Venture Company|Venture Co.]] [[goblins]] runs above it. From here, [[Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle]] oversees a good portion of the Windshear Crag operation.

[[Nizzik]] has also set up shop near the water-wheel.
